about: Publication months of the public learning documents (aa.learning_document.month), researched 2026-10-23 from each document's own date: the date printed on it or in its title, else its web page's publication date. A month is set only where that date's year agrees with the year recorded; where no year was recorded, both are set. Applied by scripts/set_learning_months.py (id AND title must match, an existing month is never overwritten).
